text:
alex: Hey folks — spotted two small things while triaging the prompt-evals runbook: 1) an external embed (CC license) is missing attribution and 2) one inline link to /runbooks/prompt-examples.md 404s in staging. Can someone grab a tiny PR?

maria: I can pick this up today. Which file should I edit?

alex: Thanks! It's /docs/runbooks/prompt-evals.md — near the top under 'Resources'. The CC embed looks like this:```
> Embedded content: Creative Commons — CC BY-SA 4.0
> source: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
```
Seems the attribution line is missing and the embed also references a raw gist that 403s.

sam: quick heads-up — if you change the embed, please also add a comment in the frontmatter: `doc-maintainers: prompt-team` so ownership shows up in the docs sweep.

maria: got it. I'll add the attribution line and swap the gist out for the canonical archived copy. planning to open a tiny PR (edit + changelog entry).

link-checker-bot: automated-scan: found 404 -> /runbooks/prompt-examples.md (status 404) in docs/runbooks/prompt-evals.md line ~120 :eyes:

leo: FYI the prompt-examples page was renamed in the last refactor to prompt-samples.md — we should link to that. Also consider a redirect if old shortlink persists.

maria: perfect — I'll update the link to `/docs/runbooks/prompt-samples.md` and include a short note in the PR description describing the rename so search doesn't get confused. PR will include: 1) fix embed attribution 2) replace gist url 3) update 404 link to prompt-samples.md 4) add `doc-maintainers` frontmatter.

alex: ideal. No need for a full review if it's just attribution + link swap, but ping me in the PR for a quick eyeball. If CI lint flags frontmatter ordering I'll fix that before merge. :thumbsup:

maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8123 — small, 6 lines. tagged @alex @sam. will merge after a quick glance.

sam: lgtm from me if CI is green. Thanks for taking this.

alex: thanks! tagging product docs triage for awareness: @docs-triage (not urgent).

link-checker-bot: follow-up-scan scheduled in 10m.

maria: merged and deployed to staging — re-running the link-checker now.

link-checker-bot: scan result: no more 404s in prompt-evals runbook; embed attribution present. :white_check_mark:
